name: omnivyra-ts7-gate
description: Isolated TypeScript 7 compiler for the advisory readiness gate. Deliberately a SEPARATE package tree: installing typescript@7 into the root would claim node_modules/.bin/tsc and silently swap the compiler used by typecheck:backend-tests, the pre-commit worker typecheck and CI. Root stays TypeScript 6.0.3. See scripts/typecheck-ts7.js.
